name: Spectral TV
description: Build always-on virtual television channels from your Jellyfin library with weighted programming, sequential or random episode progression, promos, bumpers, commercials, station IDs, M3U streaming, and XMLTV guide data.
overview: Always-on virtual TV channels for Jellyfin

versions.changelog: Development beta for Jellyfin 12 Linux/Synology with startup isolation, package safety validation, and automated Jellyfin startup smoke testing, plus weighted programming, filler pools, persistent playout, M3U/XMLTV Live TV integration, and dashboard controls.
